I served for 25 years as a U.S. Navy Captain serving alongside SEALs and Army Special Forces and taking down terrorists who wanted to see America destroyed. But I NEVER thought I’d have to face such dire enemies right here at home. The Democrats are taking America to dark places I could never have anticipated while I was serving, and now, I’m answering the call to defend freedom once again. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | TEXT HUNG TO 21412 | Hung knows the American Dream is worth saving - because he’s lived it. Now, he’s running for Senate to defend it from the next generation. Hung Cao came to America with little besides the clothes on his back, and after his 25-year career in the Navy, he’s not done fighting for our future. body:
There’s no margin for error here. Especially when my opponent is Kari Lake.
#

Peter: I am writing to you this evening to see if you can make a donation to my campaign.
I’m asking because your donation will help us hold control of the U.S. Senate. It will help us keep Trump out of the White House. And if we can do both of those things, we can keep our democracy safe from folks like Kari Lake and Donald Trump.
[**If you’ve heard enough, and if you’re willing to make that donation, please use this link to chip in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-feb24.Oewwi1&refcode=em240208-2-120&t=1&akid=1939%2E734936%2EFgjOMo)
[DONATE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-feb24.Oewwi1&refcode=em240208-2-120&t=2&akid=1939%2E734936%2EFgjOMo)
Look, I never expected to be here. Kids that grow up like I did don’t usually get to run for Senate.
But I’m a fighter. I fought hard to get into college. I fought in Iraq. I fought for the issues we care about in Congress. And I was ready to fight to defend the Capitol on January 6th.
If I get to the U.S. Senate, I’m going to fight for you.
The math is really tough right now. We barely hold the Senate as it is, and if we lose even one competitive race this year the GOP could take control.
There’s no margin for error here. Especially when my opponent is Kari Lake — the MAGA Queen, Trump’s biggest cheerleader, and fresh off a big fundraiser with a bunch of rich QAnon activists.
We can’t let her get anywhere near the Senate. At the end of the day, those are the stakes here in Arizona.
And it’s why I need to ask you, one more time, to make that donation. If you can afford to chip in $5 or $10 that would be great. If you can only give less, that’s great. If you can give more, that’s great, too. [**Please, just make that donation.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-feb24.Oewwi1&refcode=em240208-2-120&t=3&akid=1939%2E734936%2EFgjOMo)

body:
There are just 26 days until our election
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37424%2E3422442%2ERTne4g)
Derek,
There are just 26 days until our election and Californians are already casting their ballots—I just met one of them, Tiffani!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240208-2?refcode=em20240208-37424&refcode2=37424_3422442_RTne4g&akid=37424%2E3422442%2ERTne4g)
**Here in California, it’s Election Month, not just Election Day. Californians all across the state are filling out their ballots right now, and our campaign has a big task at hand:**
1. Win the support of the **20-30% of voters who are undecided** about who they’re voting for.
2. Make sure Porter Supporter ballots make it off of kitchen counters and into ballot boxes or back into mail boxes by March 5th.
3. **Remind voters that there are technically two Senate elections, one for a normal six year term, and one for a two month remainder of the late Senator Feinstein’s term—and we need them to vote for us twice.**

**[Can you chip in today to help power our campaign in this final stretch?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240208-2?refcode=em20240208-37424&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37424_3422442_RTne4g&akid=37424%2E3422442%2ERTne4g)**

5 years of the Green New Deal.
#
Five years ago, Alexandria stood up with Senator Ed Markey to introduce a vision for social and ecological transformation big enough to save our planet: the Green New Deal.
The critics jumped against it immediately. They said it was an impossible dream.
And they were wrong.
Alexandria describes the major strides we’ve made in the last five years in the video below — [take a look and, if you can, make a $5 donation today to power our fight for a better future with a Green New Deal.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-gndvid.fKm5N9&refcode=em20240208-5789-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5789%2E2526796%2ED-Nu7D)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-gndvid.fKm5N9&refcode=em20240208-5789-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5789%2E2526796%2ED-Nu7D)
**[Watch the video →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-gndvid.fKm5N9&refcode=em20240208-5789-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5789%2E2526796%2ED-Nu7D)**
We shouldn't settle for anything less than transforming our society and economy for the better to save our planet.
The powerful say it’s impossible. **Don’t listen to them.**
The world we are fighting for is here, and we work to grow it every time we replace fear and isolation with solidarity and action, with love for our fellow Americans, global community, and the planet.
[We can be whatever we have the courage to see. Watch the video and join us for the next chapter of the Green New Deal today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-gndvid.fKm5N9&refcode=em20240208-5789-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5789%2E2526796%2ED-Nu7D)
With resolve,
Team AOC

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: outraged
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Planned Parenthood thinks you’re stupid.

They think you and I won’t notice or care about all the effort they’re putting into encouraging schoolchildren across the country to become sexually active – _or how your tax dollars are paying for it all._

That’s all I can think after watching Planned Parenthood’s latest video, which has gone viral over the past week or so . . .

In this video I’m talking about _(which is clearly targeted toward schoolchildren – mainly middle schoolers),_ an “educator” in a classroom tells viewers:

_“Virginity is a completely made-up social construct.”_

_“It’s a term that was created simply to control and shame people – especially women . . .”_

_“. . . It’s time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity. What if instead of ‘losing something,’ we reframe it as gaining?”_

**Pro-Life Friend, Planned Parenthood’s message to schoolchildren _(especially young girls)_ is clear . . . Be a rebel. Have “fun.” Have risky sex!**

**[If you’re as sick and tired as I am of paying for this filth with your tax dollars, can I count on you to please sign your DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD petition IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, it disgusts me that I even have to write you this email – _and that our country has fallen this far._

The fact that our country simply hands $600 Million of our hard-earned tax dollars to an organization that commits over 374,125 abortions every year _(killing 1,025 babies every day)_ is an outrage.

_And then we give these same bloodthirsty radicals access to our kids too?_

After all, in many states, it’s Planned Parenthood that either teaches or supplies sex-ed curriculum, which sets the kids they teach up for a lifetime of pain and regret stemming from promiscuity and risky behaviors . . .

But they don’t care – _so long as their bank accounts stay fat_.

_“I want a Lamborghini”_ is how one Planned Parenthood Director put it some years ago when she was caught selling body parts from recently-aborted babies for cash.

As more states passed abortion prevention laws _(thanks to your support!),_ Planned Parenthood needed a new “market” to keep their coffers full.

So today, their bulls-eyes have landed squarely on the backs of schoolchildren.

_Many people I talk to are shocked to learn that Planned Parenthood is now the leading vendor of sex change hormones in states that leave their children unprotected from these predators_.

But abortion will always be Planned Parenthood’s bread and butter, which is why – as Fox News reported last fall:

_“An executive director at a Planned Parenthood’s sex education arm claimed that children are born ‘sexual’ while simultaneously advocating for . . . porn literacy.”_
It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out what Planned Parenthood is doing.

Monica Cline, a former Planned Parenthood sex educator who later repented and became pro-life, stated, **“These programs are about sexualizing children and leading them to abortion.”**

**[>>> SIGN YOUR DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD PETITION <<<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-j/)**
It’s all getting worse by the day.

In fact, Planned Parenthood workers were caught red-handed on video by _Project Veritas_ recently admitting they assist young people with hotel rooms and travel plans to help them have abortions without their parents’ knowledge!

Pro-Life Friend, **it’s time for you and me to rise up and DEMAND an end to all of this.**

The fact is, with the power of the purse, House Republicans under Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA) could end it all – _if they want._

_They could simply REFUSE to send one more single penny to Planned Parenthood in their appropriations bills_.

And if the Senate won’t pass government-funding legislation without funding for Planned Parenthood – or President Biden won’t sign it – let them explain to the American people why they’re shutting down the government.

Let them explain why they’re so insistent on taking the tax dollars you work so hard to earn and giving that money to an organization that:

**>>>** Puts hundreds of thousands of little boys and girls to death every year;

**>>>** Permanently damages the bodies of little kids with sex change hormones;

**>>>** Encourages middle schoolers to have sex; and

**>>>** Preys on them for abortions.
**[>>> SIGN YOUR DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD PETITION <<<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-i/)**
If pro-life leaders in Congress would tell the truth, the American people will rally to them to put a STOP to this madness.

_And that’s the LAST thing the Abortion Lobby wants – especially with everything that’s at stake in 2024_.

Pro-Life Friend, Republicans have been scrambling to try and figure out how to counter the Abortion Lobby ever since _Roe v. Wade_ was reversed.

**The ONE thing they haven’t yet tried is simply telling the truth.**

It’s saying . . .

**Abortion is wrong. It’s killing a human being. It should be illegal. And those who commit abortions should be in jail.**
It’s time our allies started fighting, Pro-Life Friend.

But I need you to help ensure they find their backbone.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD petition immediately](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-d/).**

But I hope you won’t stop there . . .

**[I hope I can count on your most generous financial support as well](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-h/).**

When it comes to ensuring Congress listens to us, every dollar is critical.

And with your support, _Students for Life Action_ will:

**1) _Use U.S. mail & email to contact up to eight million Americans_**, urging them to sign “DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD!” petitions just like the one I’ve created for you. These kinds of numbers will really make an impact on Congress;

**2) _Work talk-radio lines, print media, and cable TV news shows_** as _Students for Life Action_ is well-known for our massive media program where I’m a frequent guest on cable TV news and a prolific interviewee and op-ed writer;

**3) _Roll out a full-scale digital effort_** , working highly-trafficked blogs and using social media to pressure Congress; and

**4) _Craft hard-hitting radio, newspaper, and online ads_** targeting members of BOTH parties who are standing in our way.
Of course, none of this can happen without your support, **[so please agree to give as generously as you can – whether that’s $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-k/).**

**[Even if all you can give right now is $10, please consider it](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-u/).**

I don’t know about you, but I believe it’s time to put Planned Parenthood on the run for a change.

This battle can do that.

These predators have become so brazen, they think nothing and no one can touch them.

They think they can get away with anything.

It’s time to teach them a lesson.

It’s time to hit them where it hurts.

**[If you agree, please sign your DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD petition and agree to your most generous contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25 TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-o/)!**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. - The message in Planned Parenthood’s video to schoolchildren _(especially young girls)_ is clear . . . Be a rebel. Have “fun.” Have risky sex.

They’re literally grooming young schoolchildren to have abortions!

It’s time we DEMANDED that Congress defund these predators.

**[If you agree, please sign your DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD petition and agree to your most generous contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25 TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sduuuz-duchtdja-b/)!**

subject: Echoes of Envy
body:
I get asked every day why all of this happened. Simply...Why? Seven years ago, an advisor closely witnessed Matt Tyrmand’s behavior alongside me while

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zodct30kf6krau7k25255t0tb3kalp4b8gnitccg_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm2or6cdh2bs)

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkb4k70qarq29pg4u4tdk0sdm9n040ql3sb8vkt0_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm2or6cdh2bs) Dear Friend,

This week is the one-year anniversary of Matt Tyrmand and his friend Dan Strack leading a 6-hour Maoist "struggle session"-style board meeting flogging me for taking SUVs to meetings, stealing pregnant lady's sandwiches, and, amongst other things, claiming I'm a terrible leader. I have a recording of that meeting that I never released.

Matt Tyrmand said Project Veritas didn't need James O'Keefe anymore and would be fine without him. That, along with his statement, "You didn't build that, your employees did," sounded right out of the Labor theory of value, one of the pillars of Marxism. He seemed to want the farm without the farmer or the golden eggs without the goose that produced them. This is a common problem with nonprofits in general. Nobody owns anything; therefore, no good deed goes unpunished - if you have the wrong people involved.

My main concern in the board meeting one year ago tonight, while I sat there quietly being flogged for hours, was indemnifying our journalists because I knew the organization would run out of money if they voted me out. That action would leave our journalists, who needed defending, hung out to dry. The ongoing lawsuits affected 1st and 4th Amendment principles, particularly unconstitutional FBI raids and accompanying search warrants. I never settle lawsuits on principle because I refuse to bear false witness on the 1st amendment and choose the challenging, expensive route of dying on every 1st amendment hill. I can only do this by making the final decisions about raising and apportioning money to litigation. Our cases remain in the circuit courts, with some inevitably bound for the Supreme Court. Since making these final decisions and having the backs of our journalists is central to the sanctity and integrity of the journalism itself, my journalism and being the CEO and final decision-maker are inextricably linked.

So, I had no choice but to ask the board to resign. They refused. They also refused to consider or even fathom the indemnification issue. The "struggle session" indicated they weren't even interested in dialogue. They informed me I needed to take my lashings and feel remorseful. The board eventually resigned months later, anyway, after they spent millions of dollars and ran out of money. It wasn't until then that they started to confront the indemnification issue (you can ignore reality, but you can't ignore the consequences of ignoring reality) and began to send out emails asking their audience to pay the legal bills of those raided. Then, to the shock of the few remaining Project Veritas staff, leadership used the little money they raised from the fundraising emails not to support legal defense but to pay themselves. This irresponsible conduct was so unconscionable that it led to their own lawyer's resignation.

After being fired, I had the impossible task of somehow raising funds to pay Project Veritas journalists' legal bills while starting a new venture (OMG - O'Keefe Media Group) from scratch and with absolutely no infrastructure. If that wasn't impossible enough, Project Veritas - the company I founded- sued me and asked a Federal Judge in New York to issue an injunction to stop me from working. Now, things started to seem demonic.

This led most of Project Veritas' donors and audience to believe the worst-case scenario - that people were compromised, pinched, or worse. While that is certainly possible, I don't know that to be true. However, the timing did provide undeniable circumstantial evidence. What did Matt Tyrmand, Dan Strack, George Skakel, John Garvey, and Joe Barton think people would be going to assume after taking such a drastic action of 'indefinitely suspending" James O'Keefe only a week after the Pfizer story?

Donors and the audience were going to conclude that the Project Veritas Board was evil, stupid, or compromised.

Then, in a late May board meeting, a day after Dan Strack quit, there was a stand-off where staff demanded Matt Tyrmand resign after he said he wanted to "carve out James heart and eat it in front of him." I have a recording of that meeting and have not released it. George Skakel, previously an ally of Tyrmand, wrote a letter demanding Tyrmand resign or be fired. Tyrmand resigned in July and promised that dirt on James O'Keefe would come out to the media. Under his brief leadership, Matt Tyrmand managed to burn through the $10 million I raised before being fired. After I left, almost nothing was raised, and donors demanded their money back. Matt also hired a new CEO who fired the entire staff before she, too, quit.

Coincidentally, there was a police report filed over stolen checks around the time that happened, and people are still trying to get to the bottom of that.

Over the last year, Matt Tyrmand has sent pornographic posts and sexually harassing text messages that are so obscene I can't post them or describe them here without the risk of being banned on this platform. I still do not understand why a person would be compelled to do that.

Matt Tyrmand's initial strategy, when asked by people what he was thinking, was the somewhat effective "Adam Schiff approach" -"James has done something terrible, but I can't tell you what it is. It will come out later." This approach was used on Trump regarding Russia by Congressman Schiff. In my case, it worked on some people until they learned that Matt had already released everything he had. Whatever he knew, he would leak and share immediately. To this day, the standard response from those responsible for the destruction of Project Veritas is, "You don't know what you're talking about." When asked what they mean, no new justification or evidence is given. All that is provided are insults, pornographic images, and slurs. I have hundreds of these communications saved from some former employees and board members who often use anonymous phone numbers and X accounts.

I get asked every day why all of this happened.

Simply...Why?

Seven years ago, an advisor closely witnessed Matt Tyrmand's behavior alongside me while we were on his boat. One day, the advisor pulled me aside and warned me that Tyrmand "wants to be you, James. He's jealous of you." Looking back, I was oblivious to it, and the events described above would have been inconceivable in my mind back then. Again, I was raised to believe in the best in people. Someone taking a more Hobbesian approach to human nature would not have founded Project Veritas or chosen my path.

The lesson here is how jealousy and envy can destroy a man in the worst way and destroy organizations and even movements. It is a disease in our politics, institutions, economics, and humanity. Envy is the root of all socialism. Envy has led to death and destruction throughout the 20th century. Envy is inherent in human nature and one of the things we fight against.

It is a spiritual battle, a tale as old as time.

This was the anniversary of that fateful board meeting when I was escorted out of the building in tears, a building that my sister, an architect, helped me construct and design back in 2015. A building that was flooded and destroyed and had to be rebuilt again back in 2021 in the face of constant defamation, raids, and lawsuits. Things can be destroyed in a moment. It takes so much time to build.

But I am grateful to have the overwhelming toxicity entirely removed from my life. The cancer is all gone. I am liberated now. My greatest mistake was not firing Dan Strack immediately when he told me in the Summer of 2022 that he would not follow my lead. I commit to you, my audience, to never make that mistake again.

There is more to say, but at the moment, I have more pressing things to do, like producing our story for Wednesday about yet another institution we infiltrated. Footage you wouldn't believe unless you saw.

And see it you will, 4 pm - 6 pm, every Wednesday, "ON THE INSIDE w/ James O'Keefe"...Tune in then, and **[any support you can offer to continue our mission is, as always, greatly appreciated](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zre3oeopuj064nudeuggtvho230bpi702vf5b07o_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm2or6cdh2bs).**

In Truth,

James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Bring The Federalist Papers to your home
body:
You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2comcdp9sfha3ni0t94vtkgdnqtnaiot07m2e80_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm6ob6chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3l4ocferd9ravqug93v04m0ba0n4hefdk05n390_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm6ob6chh2bs)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zk6l6qbf9kmabi68847cmqeomoeqh9ng4qt0lv80_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c5jm6ob6chh2bs)
---
| | _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. Hillsdale’s faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles—maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won’t last long. name: Freedom First Project
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-KgskiQvgDHhDQ) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. ArnnPresident, Hillsdale CollegePursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1XUggp7UjVSW3-MbbKtKig~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1XUggp7UjVSW3-MbbKtKig~~/AARclAA~~~) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1XUggp7UjVSW3-MbbKtKig~~/AARclAA~~~)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1XUggp7UjVSW3-MbbKtKig~~/AARclAA~~~)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

The Supreme Court on Thursday [seemed skeptical of arguments](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO8yAQBOCnsTui9YINFBR_ky5_e6WFYUn2hI2FcaJ7-1NOV145M82n-bjNN8-Zt_t_v5Jrqcw-NH7SjMIKVLPqo0tESLInN2jQylg5QP9wwWKMNoEhmxCV1aMHOY1qGkwcB-17dgioAMEOMFoYL8kDxGVMNgYIUcdOAUVupV4-C2_tQSl_lSfVSyhrn92jtf3o5L8Orx1e_b7R63hP71Abh0wdXo9zr7SSCOWsTfB2nLVSaFw20eq57uJtEJR_O2m1V2aIaMy0TGpZPEwLqpRkBJmk7quL-4tz5mPSnYL76jn_eNpf53wHAAD__6C5ZNY) made by several states that they could legally keep Donald Trump off election ballots under the "insurrection clause" of the Constitution. Conservative and liberal justices alike indicated concern over individual states deciding who can run for national office without Congress authorizing it first. They focused very little on whether Jan. 6 represented a legal insurrection. The Court has no deadline for its ruling, but the justices seem to be moving quickly. Friend,

I've been fighting against the establishment my entire life.

I fought the establishment in the state house, I did it as governor, and I'm doing it again, **RIGHT NOW.**

I don't back down to bullies.

I fight. And I win.

When my parents moved here legally more than 50 years ago, they taught me that America is _**ALWAYS**_ worth fighting for because we are _**BLESSED**_ to live in this country.

We have a country to save, and I won't back down in this fight.

That's why this race isn't over, and I won't throw in the towel.

We have a world on fire and a country in chaos.

70% of Americans don't want to see a rematch between Joe Biden and Donald Trump because they're both burdened with chaos and investigations - and let's face it, they're declining.

**We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership.**

We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves.

A president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies.

Most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop the self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud!

The bottom line is: We have a country to save and I'm ready to get the job done.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I've been fighting against the establishment my entire life. | | | | | | Friend, I've been fighting against the establishment my entire life. I fought the establishment in the state house, I did it as governor, and I'm doing it again, RIGHT NOW. I don't back down to bullies. I fight. And I win. When my parents moved here legally more than 50 years ago, they taught me that America is ALWAYS worth fighting for because we are BLESSED to live in this country. We have a country to save, and I won't back down in this fight. That's why this race isn't over, and I won't throw in the towel. "But I need your help to fund my fight." | | The one thing you should know about me is - I won 't stop fighting for what's right. We have a world on fire and a country in chaos. 70% of Americans don't want to see a rematch between Joe Biden and Donald Trump because they're both burdened with chaos and investigations - and let's face it, they're declining. We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership. We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves. A president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies. Most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop the self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud! The bottom line is: We have a country to save and I'm ready to get the job done. But I need to know you 're with me. - "So will you chip in a donation to my campaign right now and help us make history?" Let's do this! My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. body:
You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc6ad935e20f44c4a9a034d01c839f90&_e=CL7_uQB-7EOgIZ9S3cATZubSgq61sFSupFtmMfJBwKl8obNgJQ0xn4XMmpTZyZ0_GVjdmxLO4QXI37QVIGyiX2ppFrJANIWISpgJwTpQVSQP1b7eVHPk4DyLohP71ZXwI3WXnUSgr_je-4pVpTXH6SfpomBfKUhY-pFvXr5gBPIBxuF3zx9Dm-BiDNVW_F0hnpUPT-7IMg7s9eTFtVGfBXjEfJNbM8Jj0hbVl8zPElCHtpVdc_P4UBKEcnywPC75D-5Ax0Iwq8lnOID-KdCdwlbJgN0MAGa7PrqeQBnvM8LaP9iYRXcqKHNcCDS1JuQ9mvGnJM-Vml1621uvXZwkkEcvmgiafCkSU4dK9Er9WMgFGmMhitFSoqrrpJQQCCvgvcqgCUdBpvqcDt02hcsxQ4ZFyCxgfGy06pfd829bbT4%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc6ad935e20f44c4a9a034d01c839f90&_e=CL7_uQB-7EOgIZ9S3cATZubSgq61sFSupFtmMfJBwKl8obNgJQ0xn4XMmpTZyZ0_GVjdmxLO4QXI37QVIGyiX2ppFrJANIWISpgJwTpQVSQP1b7eVHPk4DyLohP71ZXwI3WXnUSgr_je-4pVpTXH6SfpomBfKUhY-pFvXr5gBPIBxuF3zx9Dm-BiDNVW_F0hnpUPT-7IMg7s9eTFtVGfBXjEfJNbM8Jj0hbVl8zPElCHtpVdc_P4UBKEcnywPC75D-5Ax0Iwq8lnOID-KdCdwpa3Z6j8hY_vi7J7_u1Y52oma_KK61y0eM8a7ijHF4RtSd0zfATWmfUc5DalNHhE9GzaOcS3sKAw5u3HSN_fTMy1iBV-Vz6LbMwrmPg4228br8QMMLPx0I5XtCgAz1koT6hRX8aFwZhltBeO9Lg7yek%3D)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is flawed , outdated , and incapable of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: The Federalist Papers. | | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, The Federalist Papers were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. Hillsdale’s faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles—maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a521dfe63e38466e810e65f9767c888e&_e=pZiEmbLpKxJi7qS9NF6dYWYlV797kDUTgrg03HHNJxZ-d5O7OMTv-2XCmX23dd0jMC-GrKRhgf7Tc6eJTLqAzUp2pYiH-VlLbomA_Cq7XsOx97P0reITwvpoLUJrUAmVMAG6_scaeFTSalZOfXJckic4k99mOuR2gTnvIcd6HyEHv45cB3sBb3x1eM8PkKf8Iz7DDtMz_7Np1kAoTJWCYT3T8TrsARKMQ8dzb3X1wpqZdqdPIB0ytoYgJapIybFWQ4JxBZX119yVsKCqhGRePW96qW01YBVcHkT4BPTYhkuoeZTXTGa9t0tVlOh4E9Rbf240ZyA_qUA4_Mj7ZNBqJ_qrvqK2YwikOnVC4orqm8l0f-eRlndZJ04vw2uAzrNNyOa4KD4Rt0IA1ZLweQh-SM2njyS66Wdyap3U_mODdXc%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a521dfe63e38466e810e65f9767c888e&_e=pZiEmbLpKxJi7qS9NF6dYWYlV797kDUTgrg03HHNJxZ-d5O7OMTv-2XCmX23dd0jMC-GrKRhgf7Tc6eJTLqAzUp2pYiH-VlLbomA_Cq7XsOx97P0reITwvpoLUJrUAmVMAG6_scaeFTSalZOfXJckic4k99mOuR2gTnvIcd6HyEHv45cB3sBb3x1eM8PkKf8Iz7DDtMz_7Np1kAoTJWCYT3T8TrsARKMQ8dzb3X1wpqZdqdPIB0ytoYgJapIybFWQ4JxBZX119yVsKCqhGRePX-tiTlgTSC3_ttN4ZiPQoTehlHnGQ0TtquBFlEQI5yqcayyiImeLfVIT1vx0ZFFCaIoVPz6UZyuvwq4JHwutthCibVHpqk5gSRfj63or8euSfrAhCDXR2TtiSuYu080BD-jRq-8KXhIqZuj2vs1HHA%3D)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

name: Andrew Hughes
subject: Are you fed up with cancel culture?
body:
Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country

|
---
| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=74b4e50b0d50409c99e0cb372ae3c111&_e=_6AdCjDBIBjMeyiuYeF6kfCF1UgbCFzTGlj0JfuOEbKoTYoB056yY-gipK-MpXxDHXCJZlVAqKWTwoRj6yttuMk4LichHbdhNN3TseQA9fB4ZqtzaceeznZuILy086RFrHp6Jc4mmS-z7ER1Oa1nw9wgpBZ0Wl5mVWUshTcQFeqdudS-sp5iJbOLL4ysIzlCMKdzyKXjAz78WA4JADWUBfNSteME3I2zoQUFuTKYmYkhzI4XnBabdA9v9eXCb7v_4TZBw0B6DWlbRCX2vh8911R3Vq75gTgo7hrYRRYs8eIOJe6BRgUDEqggU-2RvMCFVOtsGnfATRjA4v5bA9SN49ueqKBOmYTOGzDE1_a9BB5nD14o1Tv4OpAqtRGFj84eIQFn3irQ0mdp5earBDlg8zHlxI2Mgh0k00bduvZYx04%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=74b4e50b0d50409c99e0cb372ae3c111&_e=_6AdCjDBIBjMeyiuYeF6kfCF1UgbCFzTGlj0JfuOEbKoTYoB056yY-gipK-MpXxDHXCJZlVAqKWTwoRj6yttuMk4LichHbdhNN3TseQA9fB4ZqtzaceeznZuILy086RFrHp6Jc4mmS-z7ER1Oa1nw9wgpBZ0Wl5mVWUshTcQFeqdudS-sp5iJbOLL4ysIzlCMKdzyKXjAz78WA4JADWUBfNSteME3I2zoQUFuTKYmYkhzI4XnBabdA9v9eXCb7v_4TZBw0B6DWlbRCX2vh8917pLJzwKq3cbUP0CBs5qIsWRaayZCEuVHkJJ79rvrg6g7GWB_WaTIYwfgjak_SInXbL7IUQ_RT4a4Nc44EyvPodeoxElg4n7U7VFelphnrMv7jFwQ7uYwaKwG40PH0sjxaH2YeJQmRViSiH_oMLbD8U%3D)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country - who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you're just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture - knowing that he's broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... "Enough is enough! I'm fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what's best for the country."

If that's a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI's **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here's the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=74b4e50b0d50409c99e0cb372ae3c111&_e=_6AdCjDBIBjMeyiuYeF6kfCF1UgbCFzTGlj0JfuOEbKoTYoB056yY-gipK-MpXxDHXCJZlVAqKWTwoRj6yttuMk4LichHbdhNN3TseQA9fB4ZqtzaceeznZuILy086RFrHp6Jc4mmS-z7ER1Oa1nw9wgpBZ0Wl5mVWUshTcQFeqdudS-sp5iJbOLL4ysIzlCMKdzyKXjAz78WA4JADWUBfNSteME3I2zoQUFuTKYmYkhzI4XnBabdA9v9eXCb7v_4TZBw0B6DWlbRCX2vh891xwXnBRe-UZgIRhLjSW_9XJdVo3CHpVWHW36BybG1lz0WaDp4EOV9n4nywVPoU01Xcmwxw-CtL0vv7owMVGtO6xZHKkgizEy4vZx8afJthgtdiyZjV-InFWpSydhKh8sfdzrl6xdatZnUlZnUPDFr_Q%3D)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you'll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

clean_body: Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country | | | | | Fellow Patriot, Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped. This is something he has experienced firsthand. As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration! These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous. Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country. "Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them. The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going. But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI): " What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?" And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country. And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our National Statement Against Cancel Culture that you can review and then co-sign. Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country - who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you're just such an American. And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture - knowing that he's broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans. He can say ... "Enough is enough! I'm fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what's best for the country." If that's a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI's National Statement Against Cancel Culture. Here's the link again for you: Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country. I hope you'll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you! Sincerely, Andrew D. | | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3786fe4935de418cbd0941eefa80eaf2&_e=GVgrGpglMfcULv0eUYC3UhcPh71-gx33JbzSQutotbSmfi4ZVcgY6q0-QFh4YN9s06D2iDs2aq3JZC4ReirsPUHvbBbnQar9xiL-oABSCh2m3JbBlwt0nFws9XB9HANKx9zi5oTXrHz80tLbmiPPlNl9b2dnqsKCtr7Y9Tmewd9TPNPx7ri0i-RabhZtlRXLT17cxP26OvsRLYiW-giQVbTw-PjhIMN0T8IGLLKOcatwgbciHoXo8Eb8sWNVbAlfx_yrwAcOxhKLtApf-W9ytQXGn89fZ02sw-ClVB44KZSIt2kllgKrJCgP3ybjHRJ9r5Cwwbr5O053v1PSldKB5D8OIfShz94m760IwN4hKtqkWCLs2J1J4XVzj1ySoD4rf6mN5ycva-pXxz1p6q6avh2WclxSM5HHxR6jQ-SmSDk%3D)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: The Federalist Papers. | | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, The Federalist Papers were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. Dear Peter,
When I declared my independence from the two-party Washington establishment and announced my campaign for President, I knew it would be an all-out fight.
I knew the Democrat and Republican establishments would stop at nothing to try and block my campaign every step of the way.
And I knew I couldn’t do any of this without friends like you. _Thank you for giving our campaign a chance to earn your vote._
Right now, I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign, [and I’m writing because I need your immediate help](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=4).
I must get my name on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia.
The whole process will cost my campaign nearly [$20 million](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=5) as we fight state by state to get on the ballot.
That’s why I’m asking you to help support my campaign today.
Will you rush a special and urgently needed donation to [Team Kennedy](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=6) today? [Your best gift today](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=7) will be a huge boost in our fight to get my name on every ballot – including yours.
[CONTRIBUTE $5 >>](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=5&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=8)

[CONTRIBUTE $240 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=12)
[CONTRIBUTE OTHER AMOUNT >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=chalng_2_09_24_email_1rs2_1_nd&n=13)
The good news is I just qualified to be on the ballot in Utah, and my campaign acquired the signatures needed for me to qualify in New Hampshire – _in one day!_
The bad news is – we’ve only just begun. And we have a lot to do – _in a very short amount of time._
Getting on the ballot as an independent presidential candidate is a huge uphill fight.
Democrat and Republican candidates barely break a sweat. They cruise to ballot access, maybe paying a small filing fee or having to turn in a handful of signatures.
My campaign, however, must get more than 1,000,000 petition signatures.
With all the deadlines coming up so fast, we may have to hire petitioners to help out as well – which will be very expensive.
And there’s no doubt that my campaign will rack up millions of dollars in legal fees because of the roadblocks before us.

clean_body: I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign, and I need your immediate help. | | | | I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign, and I need your immediate help. | | Dear Peter, When I declared my independence from the two-party Washington establishment and announced my campaign for President, I knew it would be an all-out fight. I knew the Democrat and Republican establishments would stop at nothing to try and block my campaign every step of the way. And I knew I couldn’t do any of this without friends like you. Thank you for giving our campaign a chance to earn your vote. Right now, I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign, . I must get my name on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia. The whole process will cost my campaign nearly as we fight state by state to get on the ballot. That’s why I’m asking you to help support my campaign today. Will you rush a special and urgently needed donation to today? will be a huge boost in our fight to get my name on every ballot – including yours. The good news is I just qualified to be on the ballot in Utah, and my campaign acquired the signatures needed for me to qualify in New Hampshire – in one day! The bad news is – we’ve only just begun. And we have a lot to do – in a very short amount of time. Getting on the ballot as an independent presidential candidate is a huge uphill fight. Democrat and Republican candidates barely break a sweat. They cruise to ballot access, maybe paying a small filing fee or having to turn in a handful of signatures. My campaign, however, must get more than 1,000,000 petition signatures. With all the deadlines coming up so fast, we may have to hire petitioners to help out as well – which will be very expensive. And there’s no doubt that my campaign will rack up millions of dollars in legal fees because of the roadblocks before us. | Democracy is much more than voting. body:
You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6bab1cce4a6a42c19c8033bedf769c7d&_e=MYp-tdwNIXJ0nMkwnjVFgvpB6xaYeIqmA9zkgUrrkLI2ifOmTy1-V3IE2dhp3Qfc_8XzFFHORDcUZqg2dVpwNJ8Tv_BS78cN5ohBDT74OLBNHd_sCjPrDq_1xIDqpcNdGbQ1fzjDA1YkaQb61WjwqTPDZUZ59Ebm69ocpvstpkLRRVrkqgK5q7FbdrxBmQ_p3g5aP8LD3AfIJp-vroCg-ux3BU8PUxndNybvn4_QzfoiyfQWu9oei2qHDpcqdADI7Dzs6mCuvOBq7pZYh2K9_wOG_S7E_oE0t34rnXN1NnCYdb8O84mDZoW3X4YX0XHuTZfs82R8BpBmt3v_98uK9rYo9f9NW2b56Lw1HxcykVDMaVLAw0nxP0wp1ytTQBO-6vLynIgDXvji83iz_EaGgm3wAg4-QGXNAeVX1V1da4o%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.

| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Dear Friend,
Scott Perry is at it again!
As an extreme House Freedom Caucus member, Mr. Perry spent the last few days stopping important, bipartisan legislation from becoming law.
Why might you ask?
Donald Trump.
Mr. Trump, and his allies in Congress, don’t want President Biden to get any credit for legislation that will improve the lives of working families! Instead of working with his colleagues to find solutions to our nation’s problems, he continues to play political games.
It’s just embarrassing.
First, Mr. Perry voted against a bipartisan tax relief bill that would cut taxes for businesses and provide tax credits to low-income families that would lift over 5 million children out of poverty.
Then, after months of negotiation, the Senate announced a bipartisan deal to seriously address the security of our southern border and provide support to Ukraine in its war against Russia. After demanding any aid to Ukraine include border security, Mr. Perry reversed his position and now rejects this deal. He’s even gone so far as to call it a “dumpster fire.” This legislation is now likely dead upon arrival in Congress.
If you’re like me and fed up with Scott Perry playing politics with legislation that will help our families and secure our border, please contribute to my campaign here and help me fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With Gratitude,

| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z90kvcimii4ote70sjo63eb1br3g3gnkon4ltm7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg6aoj2cph2bs)

Let me introduce myself, Peter. I’m Joe Salerno. I’m an entrepreneur and an engineer, and I’m running to represent South Jersey in Congress.

From pumping gas as my first job in high school to attending college and law school to becoming an entrepreneur whose companies have employed hundreds of New Jerseyans, I’ve worked hard to get where I am. But I’m also lucky because the system used to reward hard workers.

But in 2024, working families in South Jersey are struggling to buy gas and groceries. A college degree puts students deep in debt with cripplingly high interest rates, and rent is more expensive than ever.

And our Congressman, Jeff Van Drew is doing nothing to make the lives of everyday New Jerseyans better. In fact, he’s voted against the commonsense, bipartisan solutions that would make our state stronger and fairer. | [Stop Jeff Van Drew →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78688698/454167930/-1193541971?source=SBD_JSFC_EM_FR_Welcome1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY2NDIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWRhNjExNDUtNWNjNy1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xXZcfs0pkdYW12w9o0Aw9RnqdIXqtccejY3HNRedf7o=)

Developing strategies to lower food and fuel costs? Voted against it. Lowering health care and prescription drug costs for families? Voted against it. Providing money for law enforcement agencies to investigate homicides and shootings? Voted against it.

I never saw myself running for Congress, but all that changed when I saw our Congressman, Jeff Van Drew voting to overturn the results of the election on January 6, 2021. I couldn’t sit on the sidelines anymore and watch what extremism is doing to our country. I couldn’t sit on the sidelines and watch Van Drew refuse to stand up for working families.

I’m running for Congress because I believe all kids deserve access to a quality education and a path to a good-paying job. I want to invest in our small businesses, protect a woman’s right to choose, and help end the gun violence epidemic.

name: Becky Wagner
subject: My husband is facing 10 years in prison for defending himself
body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh6ip1p3neuqs1213sqp96uscldf4vhi5gusf3ag_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkjodqh7phsj2rjiu9g5b53jgdvku6i7fg8cbepo_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0loid4ieh4nvjoh2vmr84hjq0jn09setn8bkcug_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zir1vl27pp10h1msda53jveoo3d4qt5dvjd2or38_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvestiq2epk01stkd2kseuffs4a532ta9af72hi0_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.
This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.
Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. [**_Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?_** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfsll7pd5nislp2hgr84mjj48o85rvaqmn2m8ia0_rp22sh2s8i6eo37clg61o76cph2bs) Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | www.PoliceDefense.org
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

name: Justice Democrats
subject: “The GOP Megadonor Movement to Knock Out the Squad is Building”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Another day, another headline about AIPAC. A new article from Slate
reveals that nine out of the lobby group’s top ten donors are aligned with
the GOP — including former Home Depot CEO and Trump megadonor Bernie
Marcus, an LLC associated with New England Patriots owner and Trump
supporter Robert Kraft, as well as Paul Singer, a Nikki Haley and Rudy
Giuliani donor who notoriously took crooked Supreme Court Justice Samuel
Alito on luxury vacations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240209.XTv5cC&refcode=em20240209-33244&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga ]Tweet from Alex Sammon: I ran the FEC files of the top 10 donors to
AIPAC’s United Democracy Project PAC, which only spends in Dem races.
There’s only *one* Democratic funder. The majority: Trump megadonors,
Republicans, billionaires. Will Dems seriously let them decide elections?

Why is a group mostly funded by Republican millionaires and billionaires
spending tens of millions of dollars in Democratic primaries?

Because they want to sabotage our movement and unseat the most progressive
members of Congress fighting to hold them accountable and change the
status quo.

In 2022, AIPAC’s super PAC United Democracy Project spent more than any
other outside group in Democratic primaries to support conservative
candidates. This year, AIPAC’s network could spend upwards of $100 million
to take down as many Justice Democrats incumbents as they can.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240209.XTv5cC&refcode=em20240209-33244&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga ]We’re relying on this grassroots, people-powered movement to help us
fight back. Will you rush $3 or more to fuel our work to
defend the Squad against AIPAC’s right-wing megadonor network in the 2024
primaries?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240209.XTv5cC&refcode=em20240209-33244&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga ]Contribute $3

AIPAC and its affiliates have spent tens of millions of dollars against
the Squad before, but we the people defeated them by coming together. This
is a critical moment for the fate of the Democratic Party and our
progressive movement, so we hope we can count on you again.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240209-33244-footer&t=1024&refcode2=33244_1203867_7r38Ga&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=33244%2E1203867%2E7r38Ga
