name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Let’s walk together along the path of Jesus Christ
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs6mB4hi7N

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os6mB4hi7N

Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map
Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

clean_body: Hello Friend, Many of us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place? In our fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the blind. Jesus didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone His father put in His path. To help you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of Olives This unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000, walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he confronted. I pray it will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see what God has in mind. Friend, Trump wasn't the only one who won the GOP Nevada caucus last night. **Extremism won. Hatred won._And America lost._**
I'm running out of new ways to describe just how dangerous and out of touch Trump is. He wants to weaken reproductive rights and voting rights. He literally tried to overturn the 2020 election and stop the peaceful transition of power. And now, he's promised to "be a dictator one day one" if he's reelected.
Watching Trump's campaign as an American and a proud immigrant, I am infuriated, I am disappointed, and, truthfully, I am scared.
I grew up in Ecuador, a country where political violence was the norm. Basic concepts like safety and financial security were simply out of reach for most people. When I finally became an American citizen it was one of the happiest and proudest days of my life. But underneath all the celebration, there was something else: **I was _safe_.**
You see, at the end of the day, the American Dream is about being safe — safe to express yourself, to exercise your freedoms, to receive an incredible education, to access health care, to build financial stability, and to have a say in the future of your country. That's a privilege that so few are afforded.

Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# _Gov. Holcomb Joins Other GOP Governors at Southern Border and Sends IN National Guard_
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/9aefd2ad98f68443c3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** [joined](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/2f72edc196d57f52c3d6b838967d376c/40313) Texas Gov. Greg Abbott and 13 other GOP governors at the Southern border to express their concerns with the Federal Government's handling of the border situation. Today, Gov. Holcomb announced that he is directing the Indiana National Guard to send 50 Hoosier Guardsmen to support the Texas border security mission. **What he’s saying** : “I’m proud to join so many fellow governors in support Governor Abbott and appreciate receiving an up to date, real time, on the ground detailed briefing from those on the front lines who see this humanitarian crisis up close and person stationed along the border",**Gov. Holcomb** said in a [press release](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/ea87bd2ee2edc444c3d6b838967d376c/40313).
Additionally, **Gov. Holcomb** said: “Federal negligence enforcing immigration law and the failure to secure our country’s border jeopardizes national and economic security, affecting every state, including Indiana...We’ve worked too hard in Indiana attacking the drug epidemic for more Hoosier lives to be put at risk by a constant supply of killer drugs spilled over an open U.S. border. The only way to resolve this is to stop the historically high flow of illegal immigrants crossing the border”, in a [press release ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/ed64048d395e9ac9c3d6b838967d376c/40313)sent out this morning. **What else happened this week? Gov. Holcomb** [announced](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/ebfa7f76e12ba1a2c3d6b838967d376c/40313) an additional $6.9 million in employer-sponsored child care grants to an additional 22 businesses, community groups and school corporations, bringing the total invested to $25 million.
* To stay up-to-date, follow **Gov. Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/04980b1940a53e30c3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/02987f0924ff49393947229f28c3afba/fffdea5af4a31eecc3d6b838967d376c/40313).

# The Biden Border Crisis

---
---
---
| | The current **Biden border crisis **does not stop at the border. Republicans know that the border crisis is a national issue for all 50 states. The surge in illegal border crossings intensifies the flow of illicit drugs, particularly deadly substances like fentanyl, into our state. **How did we get here?**
* In Biden's first 100 days, he took over 94 executive actions on immigration, including stopping border wall construction and ending the "Remain in Mexico" policy.
* Over 8.7 million illegal immigrants have crossed the border during Biden's presidency—more than Indiana's entire population!

**Current situation at the southern border:**
* Only 5-10% of illicit drugs get intercepted at the border.
* Seized fentanyl in December alone = 260M lethal doses.
* 34 consecutive months of rising monthly encounters.
* December saw 302,034 illegal immigration attempts, a record high.
* 169 terror watchlist encounters in FY 2023, also a record.

Fentanyl is now the leading cause of death for Americans ages 18-45, with a 94% increase in number of deaths by Fentanyl! 71% of all Indiana overdose deaths from 2021-2022 were from synthetic opioids, like fentanyl, which are mainly manufactured outside of the U.S. Hoosier Republicans are doing everything in their power to fix this issue brought on by Biden and the Democrats in Washington. Biden refuses to enforce our nation's laws at the border, so Hoosier Republicans are taking on the responsibility. Governor Holcomb is sending in the Indiana National Guard, and multiple Republican members of Congress from Indiana have gone to the Southern Border and heard from the border agents, face to face. Democrats aren't going to help Indiana. We have a huge fentanyl problem, and only Republicans are working to stop it. We need to **elect Republicans** up and down the ballot to protect our interests at home.

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Are you quitting on me?
body:
We have one last chance
| | Should I give up? It feels like I'm completely alone in this fight to impeach Mayorkas, secure our border, and finally deliver some accountability to the evil people who are seeking to destroy our country from within. Fellow American, If you're ready to quit and give up on this fight, please delete**** this message immediately. **But I will not stop until the die is cast.** We have another shot at impeaching Mayorkas next week and I'm very optimistic that we will get this over the finish line but if we lose even ONE vote of support, it may be all over. And failure is not an option because the future security and prosperity of America is on the line if we do not hold Mayorkas accountable. | | Last year, for the first time ever, a majority of Americans eligible for Medicare were on privatized Medicare Advantage plans. When Medicare Advantage was created, it wasn't a bad idea with the promise that companies could provide more health care at lower cost. But study after study shows that they actually provide less care at higher costs. Why is that? When people have health issues, the companies actually make money by not delivering health care. At minimum, people should have the option to choose between Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage. **Republicans want to take that away. That's just wrong. We shouldn't be at the mercy of for-profit companies for health care.** If Trump wins in 2024, Republicans are plotting to fully privatize Medicare. They want to "make Medicare Advantage the default enrollment option" for people who are eligible for Medicare. **_That means they want to end traditional Medicare as we know it._** Democrats are focused on putting people before corporate profits by defending Medicare, but we can't keep up the fight if we lose the White House and the Democratic Senate Majority in November. **John Teichert Releases Statement on Hogan Entry**
**February 9, 2024** – In response to former Maryland Governor Larry Hogan getting into the race for the U.S. Senate, retired Brigadier General John Teichert, candidate for the U.S. Senate released the following statement:
**"The beauty of living in this great republic that I fought to defend for over three decades is that we give Americans a choice about who represents us in elected public office. Since I announced my campaign in October, I have run on a motto of leadership, not politics, and that message has resonated with Marylanders as I’ve crisscrossed the state during these last four months. We’ve formed coalitions, received endorsements, captivated hearts and minds, and are still gaining momentum every single day. Marylanders deserve to have a choice and I welcome anyone to the race who wants to offer them one."**
Since announcing his candidacy in October 2023, General Teichert has received several endorsements from Marylanders and others including:
* U.S. Senator Kevin Cramer (R-ND)
* Congressman Mark Green (R-TN)
* Former Lieutenant Governor Boyd Rutherford
* Former Secretary of Commerce Mike Gill
* Senator Johnny Ray Salling
* State Delegate Stu Schmidt
* State Delegate Todd Morgan
* State Delegate Matt Morgan
* State Delegate Wayne Hartman
* Former State Senator Ed Reilly
* Sheriff Joe Gamble, Talbot County
* Sheriff Mike Lewis, Wicomico County
* Sheriff Craig Robertson, Allegany County
* Sheriff Matthew Crisafulli, Worcester County
* Sheriff James Phillips Jr., Dorchester County
* John Catsimatdis, Host of the Cats Roundtable
* Denny Gillem, Host of Frontlines of Freedom

name: Mark Mullet
subject: Taylor Swift and me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elect Mark Mullet
body:
What’s happening to Taylor Swift is also happening to our kids in school | | We're facing a new frontier in the digital age, one where artificial intelligence (AI) is both a marvel and an absolute menace. You might have heard about the disturbing incident involving Taylor Swift and AI-generated depictions circulating on social media. (We’re big Swifties in the Mullet house. When Taylor Swift came to Seattle, I took my kids to her concert and I’m not kidding when I say it was one of the best live shows I’ve ever been to.) **What's even more alarming is that similar incidents are happening to our children right here in Washington.** Last October, sexually explicit images of students from Issaquah High School, where my children go to school, surfaced online. What makes this case particularly troubling is that these images were fabricated by AI, using photos taken of the victims at the school's Homecoming dance in September. **Shockingly, our current laws do not adequately address this type of exploitation. As a father of six, this hits home for me, and it's why I'm committed to taking action.** **Passing good, strong public policy is the most important part of my job** , which is why I was happy to work with Rep. Orwall on legislation to address the dissemination of fabricated intimate images, ensuring that those who create and share such harmful content face appropriate consequences, like civil remedies for victims, offering them a path to seek justice. Rep. Orwall has been a leader in the Legislature on revenge porn going all the way back to 2015, tirelessly advocating for measures to combat revenge porn and other forms of digital exploitation. I look forward to the opportunity to vote on measures like this one that will protect our community. **Real change requires collective action. That's why I'm reaching out to you, my supporters, to join me in this effort. Add your name below if you support this effort:** | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78704901/454210778/2114244983?source=MM_EM_PT_180DO_240209_1_1&refcode2=3b1302c4-6dc7-ee11-85f9-002248223794&contactdata=L+cR21KyQ9sf5A64BTjicGnzuHa09IV7DEdRQHI23OMZzoCCVL57PLr8uNpDm2O7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MzAxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjEzMDJjNC02ZGM3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uOG5j7qgYPBxdLfiChkYIIvx7MZZwhcw4VbZ0qPw9rY=&emci=845b7067-d7c6-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3b1302c4-6dc7-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=45626167)

Together, we can push for meaningful legislation that protects our communities from the harmful effects of AI misuse. By standing up for our values and advocating for responsible AI governance, we can build a safer and more equitable future for all Washingtonians.
As Governor, I’ll continue this fight – you can count on me.
Thank you for your continued support and dedication to our shared cause.
– Mark

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37440%2E3422442%2EX51dbU)
Derek,
**First** : Adam Schiff started running TV ads to boost our Republican opponent, Steve Garvey, and push Katie out of the top two, which would keep her out of Congress for good.
**Then** : He started sending mail to Republican voters encouraging them to vote for Republican Steve Garvey.
**Now** : A Slate article says this “sneaky campaign tactic is a danger to all Democrats not named Adam Schiff.” Here’s what else the article says:
* _Schiff’s campaign is working tirelessly on [Garvey’s] behalf, effectively running the Garvey campaign by proxy._

* _All’s fair in politics, but it’s still a little surprising and more than a little cynical that the man who raised millions from Democrats after his censure vote for “fighting back” against the “MAGA base,” in his own words, is now using those very same millions to elevate the political prospects of a Trump-voting Republican.**In other words, Schiff is now using his coffers to fight****for****the MAGA base.** And not only in this race._

* _Although this plan might work out for Schiff personally, there are plenty of downside risks for Democrats elsewhere.**If Schiff succeeds in juicing Republican turnout for Garvey, it stands to reason that those Republicans will also vote Republican down the ballot.** Garvey himself has no shot of winning, but there may well be closer races in purple House and state legislative districts, school boards, and more that could be swung by a surge in Republican turnout that Schiff is spending millions to stoke._

* _Purely as a matter of small-D democratic representation, this runoff ought to be a rare opportunity for the state’s supermajority to express its preference._

Derek, we can’t let this sneaky play be the reason we lose Katie’s voice in Congress for good. **[Is there anything you can chip in today to help us fight back?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240209-1?refcode=em20240209-37440&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37440_3422442_X51dbU&akid=37440%2E3422442%2EX51dbU)**

**BREAKING NEWS: Another GOP opponent has launched his campaign to defeat Jon Tester and flip Montana’s Senate seat.** **[**Rush a split donation to help us build the resources we need to fight off the GOP’s attacks, defend Montana’s Senate seat, and hold the Democratic Senate majority »**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240209-1?refcode=em20240209-1&refcode2=8788_434096_F5Vge8&akid=8788%2E434096%2EF5Vge8) **[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240209-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240209-8788&refcode2=8788_434096_F5Vge8&akid=8788%2E434096%2EF5Vge8)**
---
Derek,
Today, another GOP opponent threw his hat in the ring against me for Montana’s U.S. Senate seat. **Experts are saying Montana is a complete toss-up so we have to act ASAP.**
This is a critical turning point in our race and we’re about to see a flood of outside money and attacks rush into Montana. You can bet far-right groups will spend unprecedented amounts to attack me and mislead voters.
**Mitch McConnell knows Montana is his best shot at taking back the gavel so we need to raise an emergency $1,000,000 this week to fight back ASAP. Outside groups will stop at nothing to defeat me and retake the gavel.**
**[With so much on the line, we cannot afford to lose. Rush a split donation between John Fetterman and my campaign to help us raise the funds we need to beat my GOP opponents and protect this seat.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240209-1?refcode=em20240209-1-8788&refcode2=8788_434096_F5Vge8&akid=8788%2E434096%2EF5Vge8)**

– Jon

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH1w601gsIIyTCutferbnherKQ8FTP3nOdz2AK88MVVxyKovSwNx--P6QypnK6lRkfv0tlRGBfjx2Q7Tir2yLAYhq81wF1UXm48QVJUE-uPBzmNaSQu3jHFgDPwEJCq9W0IvD7kAZvoedojaIGyVJRnQ%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH9MKP9M3XIxXyUctv3lJ1DNkcuvVCk557ygn6LOTUxMdty5zTi0CpfgfMByVX4L5pm0UR17PBGib_jTECl2nUY_XMMQeUgUW64sSHg1szbAdXLy3NtrSGxJdPo9KhR4WkBcT0Tzvj_PRVWcJMELAUaI%3D)IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

[ ](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH84sRPMUzKDEHKwFZhveLEHmyNs0OXcPGV9701KL3Hjmx4iaqOamxcx9aXzrAKzFCN0xRiuqmjvgkImFc0u39bVPCt_tByShxxwn8d2OK8f3DmmiGUmG9dkM2ppSZD7Khi2KU5OrEMSSizIBrhKXX8o%3D)
What makes [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH-WvGYWd463jBDdT322_wF79o4o7QUu5jPT7PkDPsPmBHxzWmxxxkeAzRnMZbqTWawFSZdu9kB1nP051evopXJyGkhxLNc-ZAYD-5xe4zLoMzDvUOll8b1lQIDMVco06DoHeIKYLit7weMG7YjJmLZk%3D) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH_gil7dVDgASxX6kx5H4qL3Se48pbeeIjgMniOlq7aHWWfdVXJ1jmXMGMLPZS5OsNaHeJ_kA6v0XA7qX6vUg-zhBznGI1cEp147q17gkO9UcRGxMWZp4zH7Nxa0BMhwcZRCja9bQQZ0ZXpdQqC_lC5Q%3D) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7358e660257c49259375247067a58660&_e=jkNUjIO4UWwhA3M89lHnSPJb_cO6QMCqtuf73xUf9cEiMVLezUDgEiN53cnQNFf7q-ERCKKRF5KpsdWnankP0rC5rPsdRClqah2xk6rfjjBwC8rbY0iWQ7shZwTpOta-ZUggJZg4_cVS3emFEnfzmjuQcoFm3AQED-Y8sd9gq5WdYi7xGH44_5abupbTsSQyFpYzeDo13UaYaxhVhwZXvPM-zf78lT70YkGQvSRoCsz5ZJoAd89cwrRiR7d7u7Pu4wV4Oz5F5rkYh9edKkA7HS8bCISfMxZ1vKtjZXrwC0LC0scEfqCimeKdLO5zWzhZzOMfL0NIDKaEi6qAtcjbH5dqc4XF12mHOwBc2Jb7-7zXcEODPrUqrnJiZgSvh-buYxNYoZ61B15vf11fbucVU5C2p71SZTC5H-HkvhhXbpsETinbh25arp6UzZG61uMUTysibMdPjOVjvvAl_hYHtlmJLROaBNTnWwqCzaLaVmI%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Bernie just introduced a bill to tax corporations who pay their CEOs more
than 50 times the median worker at the company. Because, in America today,
look at how ridiculous these disparities are:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14578?source=email-20240209&t=1011&akid=5315%2E5885482%2Em7D7su ][IMG]

At Coca-Cola, while the average employee is doing the work that makes the
corporation its profits, the CEO is in his giant office, counting his
bonus, and making nearly 2000x the amount of that worker. James Quincy at
Coca-Cola is making $22,822,519 per year while the median worker makes a
little over $12,000 per year. As Bernie said, that’s outrageous!

Bernie’s bill would either punish corporations with a higher tax bill or
force them to raise the pay of their workers. It’s a win-win and we need
to stand with Bernie to build support for his legislation.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14578?source=email-20240209&t=1012&akid=5315%2E5885482%2Em7D7su ]Add your name to Bernie’s Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14578?source=email-20240209&t=1013&akid=5315%2E5885482%2Em7D7su ]ADD YOUR NAME

Millionaires and billionaires don’t need higher salaries. Workers need
better pay so they can afford rent, mortgages, daycare, groceries,
medications, and more.

“The American people understand that today we are moving toward an
oligarchic form of society where the very rich are doing phenomenally
well, while working families continue to struggle to put a roof over their
heads, feed their families, and pay for the basic necessities of life,”
Bernie said upon introducing the bill aimed at closing the wealth
inequality gap in America.

If the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act had been in effect in 2022, JP Morgan
Chase would’ve been forced to pay an extra $1.04 billion in taxes or
massively close the pay gap between CEO Jamie Dimon (compensation:
$34,848,606) and the median worker at Chase. Google would’ve had to pay an
extra $3.07 billion in taxes.

This is an important piece of legislation that addresses corporate greed,
runaway wealth in America, billionaire power, and workers left behind by
an unfair system. We need to build support for Bernie’s bill today:

outrageous CEO pay and wealth inequality in America.

The terrible reality is that gun violence is a uniquely American problem. Working in the trauma bay, Brian has been on the frontlines of this crisis, and he has had to tell far too many parents that their children had died from gun violence. Every year, there are hundreds of mass shootings, and thousands die from everyday gun violence that will never make headlines. **But it doesn't have to be this way.**

The current gun violence epidemic is a direct result of decades of inaction from extremist lawmakers who put guns over the lives of people, including my daughter. Now more than ever, we need leaders who are ready to deal with the reality of gun violence — leaders like Dr. Brian Williams.

Peter,
Far too many people in every corner of our state are struggling to afford their lives due to the outrageously high cost of insulin, a life-saving drug used to treat diabetes.
We know this problem is not an illusion. The price of insulin went up by over 1,100% between 1990 and 2020. We also know some of the main reasons why: Drug markets are heavily concentrated. Pharmaceutical companies abuse and exploit drug patents. And an abject lack of price transparency pervades the entire industry.
In 2018, the Minnesota Attorney General’s Office intervened and sued three insulin manufacturers, alleging they deceptively priced their insulin products, requiring uninsured and underinsured Minnesotans to pay astronomically high out-of-pocket costs based on the list price of the drugs.
**Today, I’m proud to announce that our office has reached a landmark settlement resolving the litigation against insulin manufacturer Eli Lilly that guarantees all Minnesotans, with or without insurance, can buy Eli Lilly’s insulin products for $35 per month for the next five years – starting today.**
This settlement ensures that insulin will be accessible and affordable to every Minnesotan who needs it and is a huge victory for all of the advocates and activists who’ve fought for years, far too often through tragedy, for this outcome.

| Friends, This coming Tuesday at midnight is crossover. This is the deadline in which the Senate must complete all the work on its bills, and the House completes the work on their House bills. So it's crunch time. Beginning Wednesday, I will begin to focus on House bills coming over to the Senate.
Make no mistake. There is an all out war on your gun rights, despite all of the smooth talking by Democrat legislators to the opposite. Actions speak louder than words. This session over 40 gun control bills have passed out of the Virginia Senate and be assured they will also pass out of the House. So it will be up to the Governor to kill these bills.
Please call Governor Youngkin today and encourage him to veto all gun control bills that come to his desk. He's our only hope for ending the war on guns by the Democrat controlled Virginia legislature.

# TRANSGENDER STUDENTS
# PARENTS RIGHT TO KNOW
SB671 PEAKE
---
| SB671 Peake is a Senate bill that requires parental notification if a student expresses a desire to transition to another gender. Senate Democrats struck this bill down 9 to 6.
Creates the Youth Health Protection Act, which makes it unlawful for any individual to provide gender transition procedures, defined in the bill, for minors and prohibits the use of public funds for gender transition procedures.
The bill allows parents, guardians, or custodians to withhold consent for any treatment, activity, or mental health care services that are designed and intended to form their child's conceptions of sex and gender or to treat gender dysphoria or gender nonconformity.
The bill prohibits government agents, other than law-enforcement personnel, from encouraging or coercing a minor to withhold information from the minor's parent.
The bill establishes a duty for a government agent with knowledge that a minor has exhibited symptoms of gender dysphoria or gender nonconformity or otherwise demonstrates a desire to be treated in a manner incongruent with the minor's sex to immediately notify each of the minor's parents, guardians, or custodians in writing, with descriptions of relevant circumstances.
The bill prohibits discrimination against persons (i) providing information regarding violations of the Act to their employer or specified public entities or (ii) who make disclosures under the Act of information that evinces any violation of law, rule, or regulation; any violation of any standard of care or other ethical guidelines for the provision of health care service; or gross mismanagement, a gross waste of funds, an abuse of authority, or a substantial and specific danger to public health or safety.
The bill establishes a civil action for any violation of the Act by a clinic, health care system, medical professional, or other responsible person with a two-year statute of limitations. The bill prohibits political subdivisions of the Commonwealth from enacting, adopting, maintaining, or enforcing any measure that interferes with the professional conduct and judgment of a mental health care professional or counselor undertaken within the course of treatment and communication with clients, patients, other persons, or the public. The bill provides for enforcement by the Attorney General or a mental health care professional or counselor through an action for injunctive relief and allows a mental health care professional to recover reasonable attorney fees and reasonable costs incurred in obtaining an injunction. The bill waives sovereign immunity to suit and immunity from liability under this statute.

| Thank you to those who have pitched in to help cover my costs to communicate with you each week while the General Assembly is in session. Thank you.
Many of you have advised me that you appreciate my instructive and informative emails, regarding important bills coming before the Virginia General Assembly.
I'm delighted to continue to send you these emails and ask for your continued support so that I may continue to communicate with you.
If you haven't done so already, will you please help me offset the cost by pitching in a few dollars?
It costs about $400 per month to send out emails to keep you informed about bills coming before the General Assembly.
Would you please make a donation today to help offset the cost, so that I can continue to bring you the latest on what's going on in the General Assembly?
After serving you for 8 years in the Virginia Senate, I know how things really work in Richmond and want to keep you informed.
Please consider donating $25, $50, $100 so that I can continue to communicate with you and help you to engage and interact with your representatives to ensure accountability and transparency.

clean_body: Bills That Passed Out of the Senate & Heading to the House | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY WEEKLY RECAP SENATE WEEK ENDING 2/9/24 | Friends, This coming Tuesday at midnight is crossover. This is the deadline in which the Senate must complete all the work on its bills, and the House completes the work on their House bills. So it's crunch time. Beginning Wednesday, I will begin to focus on House bills coming over to the Senate. Make no mistake. There is an all out war on your gun rights, despite all of the smooth talking by Democrat legislators to the opposite. Actions speak louder than words. This session over 40 gun control bills have passed out of the Virginia Senate and be assured they will also pass out of the House. So it will be up to the Governor to kill these bills. Please call Governor Youngkin today and encourage him to veto all gun control bills that come to his desk. He's our only hope for ending the war on guns by the Democrat controlled Virginia legislature. | | IN CASE YOU MISSED IT | | What happened this week in the General Assembly? | | == | THE WAR ON GUNS THIS WEEK SB2 DEEDS | Just one of over 40 gun control bills Democrats introduced this year. SB2 would affect almost every law abiding citizen who carries in the Commonwealth. Senate Bill 2 (SB2) patroned by Senator Deeds, bans Virginia's most popular gun sold in America for self defense which passed on a party line vote out of the Senate 21 to 19 yesterday, February 7. | | == | == | TRANSGENDER STUDENTS PARENTS RIGHT TO KNOW SB671 PEAKE | SB671 Peake is a Senate bill that requires parental notification if a student expresses a desire to transition to another gender. Senate Democrats struck this bill down 9 to 6. Creates the Youth Health Protection Act, which makes it unlawful for any individual to provide gender transition procedures, defined in the bill, for minors and prohibits the use of public funds for gender transition procedures. The bill allows parents, guardians, or custodians to withhold consent for any treatment, activity, or mental health care services that are designed and intended to form their child's conceptions of sex and gender or to treat gender dysphoria or gender nonconformity. The bill prohibits government agents, other than law-enforcement personnel, from encouraging or coercing a minor to withhold information from the minor's parent. The bill establishes a duty for a government agent with knowledge that a minor has exhibited symptoms of gender dysphoria or gender nonconformity or otherwise demonstrates a desire to be treated in a manner incongruent with the minor's sex to immediately notify each of the minor's parents, guardians, or custodians in writing, with descriptions of relevant circumstances. The bill prohibits discrimination against persons (i) providing information regarding violations of the Act to their employer or specified public entities or (ii) who make disclosures under the Act of information that evinces any violation of law, rule, or regulation; any violation of any standard of care or other ethical guidelines for the provision of health care service; or gross mismanagement, a gross waste of funds, an abuse of authority, or a substantial and specific danger to public health or safety. The bill establishes a civil action for any violation of the Act by a clinic, health care system, medical professional, or other responsible person with a two-year statute of limitations. The bill prohibits political subdivisions of the Commonwealth from enacting, adopting, maintaining, or enforcing any measure that interferes with the professional conduct and judgment of a mental health care professional or counselor undertaken within the course of treatment and communication with clients, patients, other persons, or the public. The bill provides for enforcement by the Attorney General or a mental health care professional or counselor through an action for injunctive relief and allows a mental health care professional to recover reasonable attorney fees and reasonable costs incurred in obtaining an injunction. The bill waives sovereign immunity to suit and immunity from liability under this statute. == | BILLS THAT PASSED OUT OF SENATE COMMITTEES HIGHLIGHTS | Here's a list of Senate bills that have passed # [RINOs Lose to the Idaho Freedom Caucus](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1424602&post_id=141470545&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQxNDcwNTQ1LCJpYXQiOjE3MDc1MDM2MzUsImV4cCI6MTcxMDA5NTYzNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0MjQ2MDIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.1BuADnosukDpnrKw2LjSCOED6aLqtamk0W1j7KopBgo)
### Idaho Freedom Caucus Wins on Budget Reform
| | [Andy Roth](https://substack.com/redirect/8504eb64-8c40-4985-a752-d87da377f8ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---
---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1424602&post_id=141470545&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQxNDcwNTQ1LCJpYXQiOjE3MDc1MDM2MzUsImV4cCI6MTcxMDA5NTYzNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0MjQ2MDIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.1BuADnosukDpnrKw2LjSCOED6aLqtamk0W1j7KopBgo)

---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/sfcn/p/rinos-lose-to-the-idaho-freedom-caucus?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
Friends,
Joe Biden wasn't the only liberal to have a bad week. The RINOs in Idaho were summarily defeated by the Idaho Freedom Caucus this week. Here's a play-by-play of what happened:
*The IDFC, along with their more conservative allies in the legislature, got a jump on the RINOs and passed strong spending reforms through their budget committee. The reforms included transparency and accountability measures that would expose $1.3 billion in "fluff" \- wasteful spending that would be hard for members to defend.
*Caught by surprise, the RINOs teamed up with the Democrats and their corporate special interest cronies to undo those reforms. They refused to consider the budget committee's reforms and tried to get the budget committee to go back to the old way where they could hide their wasteful spending in large Christmas tree-type bills (they even waited until the committee's co-chair was out sick for the day!).
*While they did this, the Idaho Freedom Caucus ignited a PR war - alerting the grassroots through email, radio, and social media.
*The RINOs, in a panic, got liberal Republican Governor Brad Little to oppose the budget reforms. His poor defense - reported in the press - was a word salad that made no sense. The RINOs themselves tried to confuse the public by saying the budget reforms would make Idaho more like Washington, DC.
*But it was too late. The Idaho Freedom Caucus won the PR war and the first budget reform bill passed this Wednesday by a vote of 38-31 (Idaho's House is 59R-11D). The key to this victory is that the ID Freedom Caucus laid out a bold, conservative vision, activated the grassroots, and encouraged their more conservative colleagues to join them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5b1d3955-343c-42a2-89a0-6721602e4b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
*Seeing the writing on the wall, the Idaho Senate voted along party lines to pass the House's first budget reform bill.
*In the aftermath of defeat, the RINOs tried to show they were still in charge so they held a vote in the Idaho House GOP caucus to "retain the majority leader". She went down in flames. So now the Establishment is divided and demoralized.
The other budget reforms bills must still pass the House (and then the Senate), but this first bill sets the stage and puts the RINOs on their heels. **Needless to say, it 's no exaggeration to say that this was the biggest budget reform plan to pass in Idaho in decades!** Rest assure that the Idaho Freedom Caucus will continue to wage this battle in defense of taxpayers to the very end.
**Georgia**
In the Peach State, Republicans are once again attempting to blow out spending with their FY24 budget.
The details are infuriating. So-called "Republicans" are pushing to hand out massive subsidies to the electric vehicle industry, institute more mandates for health insurance, and allow woke DEI policies at Georgia's universities.
It's a travesty, but it's what we've come to expect under Gov. Brian Kemp.
Luckily, the members of the Georgia Freedom Caucus called out Kemp and his RINO soldiers in the legislature. Here's a statement from GAFC Chair, Rep. Charlice Byrd.
**Wyoming**
RINOs in Wyoming are also trying to blow out their budget for FY 2024.
While families are struggling to keep up with the cost of inflation, liberal Republican Gov. Mark Gordon is asking for an increase of 12% compared to last year's budget and is 33% higher than the budget from just five years ago.
It would be the largest state budget in the history of Wyoming.
Fortunately, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus is fighting back. As soon as the budget was released, they issued an op-ed. Key excerpt:
_" If the Governor's budget is approved, state employees will have seen a 30% increase in total compensation from the 2020/2021 budget. How many of you have seen your total compensation packages increase 30% in the last five years?"_
Read the whole thing at [Cowboy State Daily.](https://substack.com/redirect/a08dae55-66f3-4e75-9d44-928f81b452f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cbbb3e0e-986f-4c35-a0c1-4a7f6dcc71c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Pennsylvania**
The Keystone State has a liberal governor. Naturally, he is proposing a budget that also blows out government spending.
Gov. Josh Shapiro is proposing an 8% increase in spending (which is astonishing less than liberal Mark Gordon's budget in "red" Wyoming). It represents an increase of over $8 billion from last year's budget in Pennsylvania.
This will inevitably lead to higher taxes and more bloated government for the citizens of Pennsylvania.
Watch Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus Chairwoman [Rep. Dawn Keefer's response](https://substack.com/redirect/c744e439-1533-4277-b698-e0edc49addc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As you can see, the budget fights across the country at the state level are heating up, quickly reaching to DEFCON 1. Thankfully, our state freedom caucuses are getting loud and pushing back.
More to come as we wage these important battles.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

While they did this, the Idaho Freedom Caucus ignited a PR war - alerting the grassroots through email, radio, and social media. The RINOs, in a panic, got liberal Republican Governor Brad Little to oppose the budget reforms. His poor defense - reported in the press - was a word salad that made no sense. The RINOs themselves tried to confuse the public by saying the budget reforms would make Idaho more like Washington, DC. But it was too late. The Idaho Freedom Caucus won the PR war and the first budget reform bill passed this Wednesday by a vote of 38-31 (Idaho's House is 59R-11D). The key to this victory is that the ID Freedom Caucus laid out a bold, conservative vision, activated the grassroots, and encouraged their more conservative colleagues to join them. | | ---|---|--- Seeing the writing on the wall, the Idaho Senate voted along party lines to pass the House's first budget reform bill. In the aftermath of defeat, the RINOs tried to show they were still in charge so they held a vote in the Idaho House GOP caucus to "retain the majority leader". She went down in flames. So now the Establishment is divided and demoralized. The other budget reforms bills must still pass the House (and then the Senate), but this first bill sets the stage and puts the RINOs on their heels. Needless to say, it 's no exaggeration to say that this was the biggest budget reform plan to pass in Idaho in decades! Rest assure that the Idaho Freedom Caucus will continue to wage this battle in defense of taxpayers to the very end. Georgia In the Peach State, Republicans are once again attempting to blow out spending with their FY24 budget. The details are infuriating. So-called "Republicans" are pushing to hand out massive subsidies to the electric vehicle industry, institute more mandates for health insurance, and allow woke DEI policies at Georgia's universities. It's a travesty, but it's what we've come to expect under Gov. Brian Kemp. Luckily, the members of the Georgia Freedom Caucus called out Kemp and his RINO soldiers in the legislature. Here's a statement from GAFC Chair, Rep. Charlice Byrd. Wyoming RINOs in Wyoming are also trying to blow out their budget for FY 2024. While families are struggling to keep up with the cost of inflation, liberal Republican Gov. Mark Gordon is asking for an increase of 12% compared to last year's budget and is 33% higher than the budget from just five years ago. It would be the largest state budget in the history of Wyoming. Fortunately, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus is fighting back. As soon as the budget was released, they issued an op-ed. Key excerpt: " If the Governor's budget is approved, state employees will have seen a 30% increase in total compensation from the 2020/2021 budget. How many of you have seen your total compensation packages increase 30% in the last five years?" Read the whole thing at | | ---|---|--- Pennsylvania The Keystone State has a liberal governor. Naturally, he is proposing a budget that also blows out government spending. Gov. Josh Shapiro is proposing an 8% increase in spending (which is astonishing less than liberal Mark Gordon's budget in "red" Wyoming). It represents an increase of over $8 billion from last year's budget in Pennsylvania. This will inevitably lead to higher taxes and more bloated government for the citizens of Pennsylvania. Watch Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus Chairwoman . As you can see, the budget fights across the country at the state level are heating up, quickly reaching to DEFCON 1. Thankfully, our state freedom caucuses are getting loud and pushing back. More to come as we wage these important battles. Keep fighting, Andy Roth** President State Freedom Caucus Network P.S. | Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkU2LpDAQQH9NvCllEr8OHpp1hT300iwNewwxlnYgH5LEXfrfD_bYc55r1asHj_p7FVepjXbrb2mxTyGJEIWTQiqdBzR6zeMe_uFTUKA8B5pDJ8ps7nlDZ1Zn2JcNNBXUbQfZowdQrAMGXc0qRMbpxBeUzVLVsuK8kZnuDw9Q6MqWtRUU2JZ0mqtpwbZbWMMIB2kwpFikBwbc9sloJV1CaQvlbWb6R0pbJOxC6Ejo6JcFQyykxXBwygeHISbvsPBhJXR8RWi_x9zoCUN6nkHHORv3ZIWSdpN6dYQNX_DJvtH64KLfg0LChi34uKFK2q3nyuKsd0vYgFZqcw6VdwldImy4XfL7n3v-Tie0_nQJ5edDePnxizLgP28AZRb6efuvjdGxbgiH9TC-0tN33_MRAAD__4mKmts) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkU2LpDAQQH9NvCllEr8OHpp1hT300iwNewwxlnYgH5LEXfrfD_bYc55r1asHj_p7FVepjXbrb2mxTyGJEIWTQiqdBzR6zeMe_uFTUKA8B5pDJ8ps7nlDZ1Zn2JcNNBXUbQfZowdQrAMGXc0qRMbpxBeUzVLVsuK8kZnuDw9Q6MqWtRUU2JZ0mqtpwbZbWMMIB2kwpFikBwbc9sloJV1CaQvlbWb6R0pbJOxC6Ejo6JcFQyykxXBwygeHISbvsPBhJXR8RWi_x9zoCUN6nkHHORv3ZIWSdpN6dYQNX_DJvtH64KLfg0LChi34uKFK2q3nyuKsd0vYgFZqcw6VdwldImy4XfL7n3v-Tie0_nQJ5edDePnxizLgP28AZRb6efuvjdGxbgiH9TC-0tN33_MRAAD__4mKmts)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkU2LpDAQQH9NvCllEr8OHpp1hT300iwNewwxlnYgH5LEXfrfD_bYc55r1asHj_p7FVepjXbrb2mxTyGJEIWTQiqdBzR6zeMe_uFTUKA8B5pDJ8ps7nlDZ1Zn2JcNNBXUbQfZowdQrAMGXc0qRMbpxBeUzVLVsuK8kZnuDw9Q6MqWtRUU2JZ0mqtpwbZbWMMIB2kwpFikBwbc9sloJV1CaQvlbWb6R0pbJOxC6Ejo6JcFQyykxXBwygeHISbvsPBhJXR8RWi_x9zoCUN6nkHHORv3ZIWSdpN6dYQNX_DJvtH64KLfg0LChi34uKFK2q3nyuKsd0vYgFZqcw6VdwldImy4XfL7n3v-Tie0_nQJ5edDePnxizLgP28AZRb6efuvjdGxbgiH9TC-0tN33_MRAAD__4mKmts)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Everywhere you look, there are pieces of history forged by brave Black men and women across the country.

In February, we take the time to honor the contributions of Black Americans, celebrating how far we have come. We also take the time to recognize how much farther we have to go, pushing for our great country to live up to its ideals of equality and justice **_for all._**

The best place to start is by teaching our children, however, only 8-9% of history taught in public schools is Black history. This means that students across the country are missing out on critical education about our nation’s history.

This is why I introduced the Black History Matters Act, legislation that outlined an assessment of Black history education efforts in public schools. By showing the next generation of Americans Black history, we ensure that it is not forgotten.

**Black history is American history.**

As we continue to push for critical reforms to our democracy and our systems of justice to revitalize the American spirit, I have great hope for the years to come.

— Bonnie Watson Coleman | | [**DONATE**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78715313/454235102/-1456106164?amount=&source=&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDY4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNWU0OTEwNi03Y2M3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-9E8nYRvFtiTTKeFjTx7MiIGfhGjmvQ4nsHA1D68S1o=)

Here is what I want every single voter to remember this election.

This election, voters have a choice -- a choice to move on from chaos of the past and elect a new generational leader who not only can defeat Biden and Harris, but one who can lead our country into a brighter future.

**If you look at the facts ...**

_We are over $34 trillion dollars in debt.

60% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck. 50% of American families can't afford diapers, and 1 in 6 American families can't pay their utility bills.

Parents are worrying about what their children are being taught in the classrooms.

We've got an open border where terrorists can come through, and there are dangers all around us._

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

This election, voters have a choice -- a choice to move on from chaos of the past and elect a new generational leader who not only can defeat Biden and Harris, but one who can lead our country into a brighter future. So, as you make that choice, I want you to remind you of something...why I 'm running and how I plan to get our country back on track. | Right now, we have a world on fire and a country in chaos. If you look at the facts ... We are over $34 trillion dollars in debt. 60% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck. 50% of American families can't afford diapers, and 1 in 6 American families can't pay their utility bills. Parents are worrying about what their children are being taught in the classrooms. We've got an open border where terrorists can come through, and there are dangers all around us. That 's not us. name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c9afb48b1a194c449a733e71e0bdaa75&_e=oEY983JPhzEPb3S4LsrEpgwXp5wTGTzS2BNsWolNQ80jOcu2CmXvO6rkRJX_nq5nhkGpr56eAd_hMcxMji7S1OBfBVEgIbV7Dy2nA-xadDIAt9zcr2XuEN1OXarifz-SXG7l6ZNTa80MCW3pSP6fJlrmgjDB-CdHMEblPd_M9iECZjIu7YghMpExZKdwnJ7OlgjR2cTJcswgr_nsy1JG3jm7nt_PN_1ZUsZFhXBTbDFM_3zzuzmCfMKtli-FfcP2fvMR6eG1IyprO2sMRaur5CRtXcgOQWL1ZnwYKbrOLqi2KO1NAbfMZYvtlW12E4da44pzRRuRcXiJq9PaT_ULH4xi6tymfdagI0dAN1ndX6TSslm4mxde79xrYHYx-XMZSdriHidXmix0U0zq0y2ZgA%3D%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c9afb48b1a194c449a733e71e0bdaa75&_e=oEY983JPhzEPb3S4LsrEpgwXp5wTGTzS2BNsWolNQ80jOcu2CmXvO6rkRJX_nq5nhkGpr56eAd_hMcxMji7S1OBfBVEgIbV7Dy2nA-xadDIAt9zcr2XuEN1OXarifz-SXG7l6ZNTa80MCW3pSP6fJlrmgjDB-CdHMEblPd_M9iECZjIu7YghMpExZKdwnJ7OlgjR2cTJcswgr_nsy1JG3jm7nt_PN_1ZUsZFhXBTbDFM_3zzuzmCfMKtli-FfcP2MQMOyDQfWdW_3Mfv3JQ3Y2DLmxQYUIBKtVlIQyAkTsmohPfX02xyIgjDBTiJktVKizjmmv1ZP3-dLbsnTdJe-K0kfH7-9OMnK4IXmGdmB32BvCuMZ8r3pujUWa5A_qs-XSfpBWL7P9M4SjPmTlbRyQ%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

clean_body: America is on the brink of destruction. | | | | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making... ...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda. I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited Ramparts – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: The real mastermind is Barack Obama. Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. That’s why I wrote The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party... ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ The Enemy Within is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote The Enemy Within because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it. So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can. | | Sincerely, David Horowitz P.S. body:
You pushed us over the top. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/482418b48b3b/re-hey-9346473?e=d30db4cde8)
---
| |
---
| | Republicans,

What a night yesterday.

We made the voice of the Virgin Islands heard loud and clear.

Like many of you, this was the first time I have ever voted for president.

The caucus confirmed Donald Trump as the presumptive Republican nominee in 2024 after he won our record-breaking caucus with 74% of the vote.

The results were covered by media across the country, including NBC, USA Today, Fox News, the New York Post and The Associated Press. There was also a great story in today's Virgin Islands Daily News.

And then there was Trump himself. He personally called into the [Election Night Party](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=b18acfeb38&e=d30db4cde8) and delivered a victory speech.

I want to congratulate the other winners, incoming National Committeeman John Yob, incoming National Committeewoman April Newland, and the new members of the Republican State Committee: Jameson Engelhard, Krystal Flores, and Vanessa Mull Coffen from St. Croix and Alexandra Bonthron, David Weisher, and Mark Zion from St. Thomas-St. John.

Earlier today, the Delegate Selection Committee met to elect delegates and alternate delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention in Milwaukee. By rule, Trump gets all of our delegates after winning. We elected a nine-member delegation, six-member delegation and four-member delegation. The exact number depends upon the final allotment of delegates from the RNC.

We'll take a few much-needed days off and then get back to work as we continue efforts to build the alternative to the failed ruling party that our islands deserve.

Together, let's go forward,

Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5412%2E5257348%2EB_Ybmm ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

My roots are in Danville, California, where my family moved after my
father’s job in the clothing business took him out west.

I grew up in a community that believed in service.

From the public school classrooms, where my teachers taught me the power
of the spoken word and the lessons to take away from the history books...

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240209_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=5412%2E5257348%2EB_Ybmm ]A school picture day photo of Adam as a child

To the California forests, where I served as a firefighter and learned
about the importance of protecting our precious planet...

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240209_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=5412%2E5257348%2EB_Ybmm ]A photo of Adam as a young adult firefighter

The hard-working people of our state have made me who I am today.

Our state is built on a mutual commitment to each other. To equity. To our
democracy. To a better tomorrow for us all.

That’s why I took on insurance companies denying people the medical care
they needed.

That’s why I prosecuted polluters dumping toxic waste.

That’s why I stepped up to hold Donald Trump to account.

These are the values I’m taking to the United States Senate. California
values. A commitment to justice and equality, to freedom and opportunity.

California has made me who I am — and I would be proud to serve all of the
people of this great state in the U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240209_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=5412%2E5257348%2EB_Ybmm ]If you’re with me, please pitch in to my campaign today. Our movement
is of, by, and for the people — not corporate PACs — so I am counting on
your support to help me make it to the Senate.

subject: Fwd: Vince: note: Join Katy Yaroslavsky & Laura to Canvass Tomorrow!
body:
Hi All,

I just want to keep us on the same page about tomorrow. Super excited to
see so much activity for Laura tomorrow!

Sorry if I missed your calls - my nonprofit work was hectic earlier today.
I’m still around via text if you wanna chat.

So, we have two canvasses going on tomorrow - the HLA canvass at 10am
kicking off at Dre’s for all HLA candidates.

Separately, CM Katy Yaroslavsky’s team just green lit a canvass for Laura
to kick off at 12pm with Laura & Katy. This canvass will be dedicated to
just getting out to vote for Laura.

Please know, we (field) agreed with Katy's team that we would *only canvas
for Laura Friedman at this one-time important event.*

So, I hope you can support this and head over at least for the kickoff to
see them both speak. If you have other plans for canvassing, we are just
asking you to join us *at noon* to kick-off this event with us for as long
as possible.

Address: Lo/Cal Coffee
487 S Fairfax Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90036, USA

Time: 12pm tomorrow (2/10)

RSVP & ADDRESS HERE:
https://www.lauraforcongress.org/event-details/canvass-with-councilwoman-katy-yaroslavsky-for-laura-friedman
<https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.lauraforcongress.org/event-details/canvass-with-councilwoman-katy-yaroslavsky-for-laura-friedman&source=gmail-imap&ust=1708139560000000&usg=AOvVaw3J90UW6goy_EFANSXzlZ_B>

Please be sure you sign up your entire group/guests tonight.

Just a friendly reminder to please bring water or snacks for yourselves or
groups.

I will be available to you if you need materials for other canvasses.

Thank you,
Vince. 323-219-1417

Friend,
---
I went on Dan O’Donnell’s show this afternoon to talk about my work to **ban the use of Zuckerbucks in our elections.**
---

[<< LISTEN HERE >> ](https://links.steil4congress.com/u/click?_t=341f45e792a04ec6b4bc19a47b2f9a18&_m=977ee8f2984f43048ae250bd4b72d9e5&_e=WaqwGLhN_IxHFXbKadbiiBWuMB_FcdpW3ZV-OR-jmh0CC4aPsJRQwgM9XL0GlQslsKWuBjwrIzmW3VXgMLu3VtizHVFSUKBeAncJS--u9XHUyGMLdgTglFSmSH2z_DiMDreIqAeP6vbNgd663wd9uAvuHz5gdL-SQvCkVRAusf_OSYio9DVKCeKiyjZpcYNp_GMlUCnTso9fW5mYN05JCxfwK86guytb9Nj6IhmIU9iaWmgS8hCetAnx3lsP_85vhCDhNLUub1FaQCaJJZ7gwLji_PsY_NfEI2KtGGGtg57Ek6hPHM-2nrofF2rwQZN0OHVWlcO60d3iYuNBm0rZTMk7JqdGqUwSDz_YWj7xZy5ri0xZtZqniOQJna4CLQvY5v9oAJz3ItiIMQrD-wurBrJ_rDoB6k_l9xGqNIcGlXQcR-pOuzX0dduBiAo-Rx4oJlPmuIolzHB8uzerXRmO8Q%3D%3D)
---
**1:25:27 - 1:32:30**
---
Zuckerbucks is a term for the private funding provided to states and local governments’ elections offices. In 2020, millions of private dollars were used to administer our elections.

---
Many of these funds were used for voter registration events and get-out-the-vote efforts in Democrat-leaning cities and counties. This created distrust in our election administration.
---
Elections are partisan, but election administration should never be partisan.
---
That’s why I introduced the American Confidence in Elections Act, which will **END the use of Zuckerbucks in our election administration.**
---
_But in ten months, the American people have an opportunity to**defeat** President Biden, **take back** the Senate, and **expand** our House majority._
---
We need to deliver a resounding election victory this year so we can implement election integrity measures that will increase voters’ confidence in our election administration.
---
**[So please take a minute to listen to my interview with Dan O’Donnell and make a contribution to support my push for election integrity.](https://links.steil4congress.com/u/click?_t=341f45e792a04ec6b4bc19a47b2f9a18&_m=977ee8f2984f43048ae250bd4b72d9e5&_e=WaqwGLhN_IxHFXbKadbiiBDdtM-M-EN2UAUv9uzmESLAeZluhuaYFKcLiczgVyGSKIzv8Zy9P7Dueq_ccMj6uHUJIyxsX0D3hE0F_xdT0MRAd-1wXP82lt_LfL0y9tBVmkDvmIJC75DmdLWfA7GdbB6Dr23h15XqdwB9FpQ3GxhaebtDs5qWxzZcELLKqiak-omzp7_wK_V1VTTzzxRWvgQtKbnowVLqWU4dVXXzSMpAOvTRQzq9t0Ji0Q5_8XaZ4qZpdx_c_sa2OxUOr2tRMOJTc_917U-j4x6X4F1S3_WorU_32kg1IrUrmz8TojGCWDlyrU98JfoJzzS5HleoSRuJLRB7LS36oeH6mkGZeriwV-wvg1pQ84LUTcWeG1qhX6Ez2UKwTuUrs1oavkRw5QbIgQgmIEwE49PsTfpgbCfELSvWepsuZMYgibbeSbrV8ibbSpTAVvDp5Uit82UZGm6Oj8F6yT_YyDnAea_ST60%3D)**

clean_body: I’m fighting to END the use of Zuckerbucks. | Friend, I went on Dan O’Donnell’s show this afternoon to talk about my work to ban the use of Zuckerbucks in our elections. 1:25:27 - 1:32:30 Zuckerbucks is a term for the private funding provided to states and local governments’ elections offices. In 2020, millions of private dollars were used to administer our elections. Many of these funds were used for voter registration events and get-out-the-vote efforts in Democrat-leaning cities and counties. This created distrust in our election administration. Elections are partisan, but election administration should never be partisan. That’s why I introduced the American Confidence in Elections Act, which will END the use of Zuckerbucks in our election administration. But in ten months, the American people have an opportunity todefeat President Biden, take back the Senate, and expand our House majority. We need to deliver a resounding election victory this year so we can implement election integrity measures that will increase voters’ confidence in our election administration. Thank you, Rep. Bryan Steil PAID FOR BY STEIL FOR WISCONSIN INC 1818 MILTON AVE. #1448 JANESVILLE, WI 53545
